All five corrections are in the spec. Here's what changed, for your review at the gate:

## Corrections applied — Bookmark Manager spec
📄 `specs/001-bookmark-manager/spec.md`

1. **Markdown notes** — notes are authored/stored as Markdown source (kept verbatim) and rendered as formatted text; no rich-text editor. *(FR-008, US3 scenario 3, entity + assumption updated)*

2. **Adjust auto title/description before initial save** — the fetched title and description are presented for editing before the first save, as well as editable later. *(new FR-003a, US1 scenarios 1–2)*

3. **Preserved page = self-contained local HTML; PDF stays PDF** — web pages are preserved as a single offline-openable HTML file with assets inlined; PDF addresses preserve the original PDF instead. *(FR-032/033, US11 scenarios 1–2, entity updated)*

4. **Search combination rules** — ordinary text + `#tag` together must **both** match (combined with AND); a quoted operator word like `"AND"` is treated as a literal term, not an operator. *(FR-014/015, US5 new scenarios 3 & 5)*

5. **"Select all matching" respects the full current view** — it covers everything matching the active search text, tag include/exclude filters, and whether you're in the unread or archive view — not just the visible page. *(FR-023, US8 scenario 2)*

Everything else from the previously approved-in-progress spec is unchanged (13 user stories, now 41 functional requirements).

If these read correctly, confirm and I'll proceed to the **plan** gate (`speckit-plan`). If any wording is still off, tell me and I'll adjust the spec before planning.
